PNL-QL-071.template: A trader buys the stated lots at different unit costs and sells them at the given unit prices. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-072.template: Two articles are sold for the same price. One is sold at a {firstRatePercent}% {firstDirection} and the other at a {secondRatePercent}% {secondDirection}. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-073.template: Two articles have the same cost price. One is sold at a {firstRatePercent}% {firstDirection} and the other at a {secondRatePercent}% {secondDirection}. Find the overall profit or loss percentage.

PNL-QL-074.template: A dealer buys {totalQuantity} identical articles at ₹{unitCostPrice} each. The stated groups are sold at different prices and the remaining stock has the given recovery value. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-075.template: A trader buys {totalQuantity} articles at ₹{unitCostPrice} each. Of these, {damagedQuantity} are damaged and recovered at ₹{damagedRecoveryPerUnit} each. Find the selling price per good article required for the stated overall result.

PNL-QL-076.template: A wholesaler pays for {paidQuantity} articles and receives {freeQuantity} additional articles free. If all the articles are sold at ₹{unitSellingPrice} each, calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-077.template: Different groups of identical articles are sold at the stated profit or loss rates. Calculate the overall percentage gain or loss.

PNL-QL-078.template: Some groups of a stock are sold at the stated rates. At what profit or loss percentage must the remaining {unknownQuantity} articles be sold to obtain an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}?

PNL-QL-079.template: The stated groups of articles are sold at the given rates. How many additional articles must be sold at {unknownRatePercent}% {unknownDirection} to obtain an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}?

PNL-QL-080.template: A dealer buys {totalQuantity} articles at ₹{unitCostPrice} each and sells the stated groups at the given prices. At what price per article should the remaining stock be sold to obtain an overall {targetRatePercent}% {targetDirection}?

PNL-QL-083.template: Two articles are sold at the same selling price. One is sold at a profit of {ratePercent}% and the other at an equal loss percentage. Find the overall loss percentage.

PNL-QL-089.template: Read the inventory caselet and calculate the dealer's overall percentage gain or loss after accounting for sold and remaining stock.
